name: Rockfield
tagline: Picnic Rock Farms – Lakes Region Farm Stand
description: Rockfield is an independent farm stand in Barrington, NH. It grows Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Peppers, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Oct in this growing zone.
